schema: CREATE TABLE emp (name INT, dept INT, emp INT); CREATE TABLE dept (dept INT, loc INT, mgr INT);
correct_query: SELECT X.NAME AS XN FROM EMP AS X WHERE (X.EMP, X.DEPT) IN (SELECT Y.MGR, Y.DEPT FROM DEPT AS Y WHERE Y.LOC = 3);

expected_mutants_to_kill.query: SELECT X.NAME AS XN FROM EMP AS X CROSS JOIN DEPT AS Y WHERE X.DEPT = Y.DEPT AND Y.LOC = 3 AND X.EMP = Y.MGR;
